description: Implement the --profile full tools: create_item, update_item, add_dependency, defer, promote_deferral, dismiss_deferral, block, unblock, drop; finding_create (draft file only, never the DB), finding_list, finding_show, finding_triage, finding_link, finding_promote, finding_dismiss; init_project and config_get. finding_sync, config_set, sweep_stale, migrate, complete, verification execution, and rebaseline are never tools. Wire the --profile flag so agent exposes only tools_work plus tools_query.

preserves.behavior: No tool can lower a lint gate or clear another principal's claim
finding_create writes a draft file and never opens a database connection
update_item is the audited amend surface, not a general JSON-patch channel (ADR 0006 G8)

work_units.evidence: Confirmed create_item/update_item param shapes and finding draft capture via findings.create_draft
work_units.summary: Confirm create_item and update_item parameter shapes and the finding draft-capture boundary

work_units.evidence: Implemented 18 full-profile tools: 9 planning, 7 findings, 2 admin via FastMCP with worker dispatch
work_units.summary: Implement the planning and findings tools

work_units.evidence: Implemented init_project and config_get; wired --profile flag so agent has 19 tools, full has 37
work_units.summary: Implement init_project and config_get; wire the --profile flag

work_units.evidence: Verified excluded operations absent at every profile (finding_sync, config_set, sweep_stale, migrate, complete, rebaseline)
work_units.summary: Assert the excluded operations are absent at every profile in tests
